name: Compromised IAM Identity & Credential Containment
description: Automated containment playbook for compromised IAM users, exposed access keys, or STS token exfiltration detected by GuardDuty or Security Hub.

actions.name: RevokeActiveSTSSessions
actions.description: Attaches an inline policy with an explicit Deny condition matching aws:CurrentTime < CurrentTimestamp to instantly invalidate all active temporary STS sessions.

actions.name: DeactivateAccessKeys
actions.description: Enumerates all active IAM Access Keys for the compromised user and flips status to Inactive.

actions.name: AttachQuarantineDenyPolicy
actions.description: Attaches the managed or inline explicit DenyAll policy SOAR-CompromisedIdentity-Containment to block all further AWS API calls.

actions.name: ArchiveForensicEvidence
actions.description: Captures CloudTrail recent API activities for the principal, records cryptographic SHA-256 hash, and vaults to immutable S3 bucket.

actions.name: DispatchSecOpsAlert
actions.description: Broadcasts incident metadata, containment timestamp, and manual investigation runbook link to Amazon SNS and SecOps Slack channel.

recovery_procedure: Rotate primary credentials and enforce hardware MFA on the user account.
Inspect CloudTrail logs for actions executed during the compromise window.
Remove the SOAR-CompromisedIdentity-Containment deny policy once account verification is complete.
